label: Root existence factors as whole-roster nontrapping, population and stability
description: Certified difference (#1598): an actual root exists iff the nonempty actual roster is not a trap, the roster is inhabited and root existence is stable. Proved constructively, with no excluded middle; the Comparator configuration also checks that whole-roster nontrapping is equivalent to 'if the actual roster is inhabited, it is not the case that no actual root exists' (wholeRosterIsInhabitedRootNotAbsent). Premise-free; it asserts none of the statements compared.
